correctness.rationale: The John contact equal-weight identity \(w=b/(b+1)\) proves unique optimality for the \(a\)-fold simplex product. Each column-cap support is exactly \((a+\sqrt a)/(b+1)\), proving the if-and-only-if inclusion and volume/contact formula. In the subcritical case, column permutation invariance and positive-definite shape interpolation contradict maximality if columns were all slack. Exact rational certificate and facet checks pass 132 cases; infinite scope rests on complete analytic proof.

value.rationale: Genuine supporting facets of a fundamental complete-bipartite matching polytope disappear from its John contact set in a sharply classified infinite rectangular regime. The threshold \(b=a+\lceil\sqrt a\rceil-1\) is dimension-sensitive, grows nontrivially with a, and determines the full ellipse/volume when it survives; a strict regime demands every column contact. This gives a motivated exact facet-invisibility and phase-boundary theorem, beyond a routine facet enumeration or ad hoc small-invariant computation.
